definitions.name: R2C.RUNSTARTS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV 1 DROP 'RC' BIND RV -1 DROP 'RP' BIND [ TRUE ] RC RP LT NOT RP RC LT NOT AND NOT CONCAT 'RS' BIND 0 RV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'XI' BIND RS XI GET ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector -> indices where a new run of equal adjacent values starts (index 0 always starts a run)

definitions.name: R2C.JOINSP
definitions.note: Vector of texts -> one text with the texts joined by single spaces

definitions.name: R2C.WORDS
definitions.note: Text -> Vector of its non-empty space-separated words, in order, case kept

definitions.name: R2C.QTYSKU
definitions.body: 'OS' BIND OS [ 'XR' BIND XR 'sku' GET ] MAP 'SK' BIND OS [ 'XR' BIND XR 'qty' GET ] MAP 'QT' BIND SK QT GROUP 'GR' BIND GR KEYS GR VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Orders Vector -> Record from sku to total qty, skus in first-appearance order

definitions.name: R2C.TAGCOUNTS
definitions.body: [ 'XR' BIND XR 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'XR' BIND XR 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
definitions.note: Orders Vector -> Record from tag to the number of orders carrying it, first-appearance order
